correctness.rationale: The transfer x_v -> y_v=x_v-max(previous layer) is an invertible unit-Jacobian piecewise-affine bijection and couples volume-uniform points. Within each layer, random within-layer order-statistic ranks and Dirichlet(1,...,1) spacings give the exact covariance-entry difference s_g(N-s_g-m_g)/((N+1)^2(N+2)) for any two labels in that layer. Summing m_g identical variance gaps counts e3(m_1,...,m_k) once over triples of distinct layers. For k<=2 an explicit coordinate reflection is a Euclidean isometry; k>=3 the positive trace gap precludes congruence. Elementary smoothing of two layer sizes differing by >=2 proves sharp fixed-N,k extremizers. Independently specializing the full general-poset linear-extension formula with deterministic ranks a=s_g,b=s_g+m_g+1 reproduces exactly this diagonal variance and e3 for compositions (1,1,1),(2,3,4),(4,1,2,1),(2,2,2,2). Source checker used independent rational simplex integrals in 127 compositions, not the Dirichlet formula; finite tests are not an all-N proof.
residual_risks: The within-layer covariance difference is not a positive-semidefinite matrix comparison.
No extension beyond canonical Euclidean metric, volume-uniform distribution or ordinal sums is proved.

originality.rationale: A general all-poset coordinatewise-variance theorem published in the same November 8 corpus supplies a rank/linear-extension formula whose deterministic-rank specialization immediately reproduces the diagonal variance and e3 numerator; these components are emphatically NOT independently new after that theorem. Crucially that full general-result text explicitly calls the ordinal-sum exact inertia expression a previously obtained strict special case, rather than claiming antecedence. Exact publication order within the shared date/aggregate Git commit is unverified, and the submitted complete within-layer off-diagonal covariance identity and sharp fixed-height optimization are not in the broader general theorem. On that evidence this older specialized finding retains a qualified best-of-knowledge originality PASS, with no assertion that its headline improves on the now-published general result.
residual_risks: Shared 2026-11-08 dates and one aggregate publication commit do not independently establish which exact identity appeared first; general paper itself describes the specialized expression as previous.
If the stronger general-poset theorem predates the specialized result, the principal e3 formula becomes mechanically covered, and O/V of the full original claim require reevaluation.
